title: Micah, Nahum, Habakkuk, Zephaniah and Haggai
summary: Five more of the Twelve Prophets are now on the site, each with a Plain English translation made from the Hebrew, study notes, the manuscript differences explained, and "Where Christians differ" cards. Many older study notes were also updated so their quotations match the newly written books.
